sentences.text:
Through the medium of this writ petition under article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioners, who are 13 in numbers and claiming themselves to be the owners of the land which came to be acquired for the purpose of construction of road from Kharpora Rattanbass Road via Shabanbass KM 1-6th at village Gund Adalkote, Tehsil Banihal, District, Ramban, are aggrieved of the final acquisition award No.SDMB/Acq/23/339-44 dated 28.01.2023 which is challenged to be a nullity in the eyes of law on account of the fact that Section 6 Notification of J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990, was issued on 16.10.2018 and by that reference, acquisition proceedings lapsed by the mandate of section 11(B) of the J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990.
02.

The petitioners plead that they have not received even a single penny of compensation so assessed in terms of the impugned award and as such, are well within their right to throw challenge to the entire land acquisition exercise as being a nullity warranting fresh land acquisition exercise under new dispensation of acquisition law.
